Seccomp policy for GUI HTTP logging, socket accept, read, send, close, and poll.

# Purpose
This file defines syscall access rules for a process that writes logs and serves a GUI over HTTP. It declares two file descriptor variables, `logfile_fd` and `gui_socket_fd`, and then uses them in policy checks for `write`, `fsync`, `accept4`, `read`, `sendto`, and `close`. The rules allow log output to go to STDERR and the log file, force immediate disk sync for warning-level log data, and permit network operations only on the GUI listen socket or on client sockets accepted from it. The final `ppoll` entry enables polling so the server can wait for activity on its connections.
